nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Degunker Blackhead & Pore Cleansing Mask System

avis.texte: It does get the gunk out but I feel like in the process its damaging my pores making them look larger. When you use the took tou cant press too hard or it will do more damage than good
Within seconds of applying the mask, my skin started burning and progressively got worse until I washed it off. left my skin red and swollen.

avis.titre: Not a gimmick. It's for real.
avis.texte: I've tried pore strips. I've tried astringents. I've tried masks. I've tried my own hands. Nothing has gotten the crap out of my face like this thing did. I was skeptical because what can a tiny little blade and a face mask do for my crappy skin? Apparently a whole lot. I can see and feel the difference. Get this!

I'm honestly loving the Degunker I picked up at Ulta — especially for the price point. It feels like a solid little skincare upgrade without breaking the bank. Here's what worked best for me: I started with an oil cleanser, followed by my regular face wash, then hopped in a warm shower to let the steam open my pores. After that, I applied the Degunker and left it on for the full 30 minutes. One big tip: when you're using the tool, keep your face wet — it makes a huge difference. The first time I used it, I didn't see a dramatic change. But when I used it again later that same week, I definitely noticed more results. My skin felt cleaner and smoother, and it's been a great addition to my routine. I'm excited to keep using it!

I wanted to love this product but unfortunately for me it didn't seem to do much for my pores/blackheads. I found you had to apply a decent amount of pressure with the tool which was very uncomfortable for little payoff. Also the smell is not great.
Applied it and it immediately started burning. Left on for not even a minute. Left my face all red and slightly inflamed.

I am a employee and was really excited ,had hugh hopes! Love the idea, but the tool is very painful and you have to realllly apply pressure to get anything. I left it on my face for a little over 15min (like instructed on bottle) and it smelled so bad ,someone across the room could smell it. Felt like it burnt my skin,because mt skin was so red afterwards and skin feels "raw" after using thr tool. Recommendation: better formula and better less painful tool.

I love the thought of this. It's just not the best specially for the price. The mask feels nice on my nose and chin. The extraction tool is painful. You have to press hard to get anything out. I would pad on this.
This didnt work how it is claimsd. I even steamed my pores before to soften sebum more. The mask doesnt work. Buy a sebum softener instead.

I got recommended this product as an employee noticed I have blackheads and such. I bought the product, cleansed my face, applied this product as intructed and it immediately burned my face! I look like i have a sunburn and hurts! DO NOT BUY

I was excited to try this product. Unfortunately, it doesn't work as described. The instructions aren't very descriptive & pressing hard with the tool on my skin actually caused me to bleed. The product didn't actually remove anything visible from my face, which was very disappointing after scrapping my face raw. The product also smells like plastic, which was weird.

avis.titre: Bad odor, too much pressure needed that hurts
avis.texte: I really like the concept of this product. I've always wanted to try it instead of pore strips, but unfortunately I'll likely stick with them. The cream you apply to your face first has a pretty bad odor, but it does go away after a few minutes. The shape of the actual device looks like it would fit the contours of your nose, but it's actually more awkward. I also found that I had to press pretty hard to see any results, which didn't feel good. The amount of "gunk" I got out of my pores just wasn't worth the bad scent, the difficulty in actually gliding it along the curves of your face, and the amount of painful pressure you need to see results.
Didn't see much improvement with my blackheads or pores. My skin got a little irritated too, and I have somewhat sensitive skin. Cute packaging though!

The clay mask cleanses well, absorbing oil and sebum from the nose, philtrum, and chin area. When using the included metal tool, blackheads and sebum plugs are easier to extract than with just fingers. After rinsing, the skin feels clearer, deeply cleansed, and pores appear smaller. However, the metal tool is a bit hard; pressing too hard can cause pain or redness, especially on thin or sensitive skin. Those with sensitive skin should use it very gently or only after the clay has softened the sebum.

avis.titre: Convenient for travel but more challenging
avis.texte: Easy to apply mask which dried down quickly. I found the debunker tool a little more difficult to work with in order to find the right angle and pressure for extraction. Rinsed cleanly. Moisturized feeling afterward. Limited extraction but I don't typically struggle with black heads. Not a noticeable change in pore size

Worked decently to get out clogged pores. However, not as effective as other products I've tried. I also didnt like the scent. Its a neat idea to have the tool included for after the product sets and it's a fair price for the product.

avis.titre: Leaves skin fresh, smooth, and pore-free without a
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by how fresh and light this cleanser feels! The texture is silky and smooth, and it doesn't strip my skin at all. It removes dirt and oil effectively while leaving my pores feeling clean and refined. The scent is mild and refreshing, not overpowering. After a few uses, my skin looked clearer and softer, and I love that it gives a nice cooling sensation after washing. It's perfect for oily or combination skin and works great before makeup too!

avis.titre: It does remove gunk from pores
avis.texte: I have mixed feelings about the Benefit Cosmetics The Porefessional Degunker. I will begin by saying that I love the concept of this product. I love that it comes with a skincare product to apply to the skin before trying to remove any gunk. The formula of the product is great and really helps when using the tool to remove any gunk trapped in my pores. I do not find the metal part of the tool useful for all over my face. It did a great job on the corners of my nose and removed a good amount of gunk there. It was harder to use on my cheek area and did not do much for my chin. I also have another metal tool that is used for popping pimples and it does a better job at gliding across my skin to remove gunk. Bottom line is that I love the liquid part of this product, but I think the metal tool is not practical for my whole face.

had mixed feelings about this product. The packaging is cute and the applicator is easy to use, but the results weren't as impressive as I hoped. It does help remove some buildup and leaves the skin feeling a bit smoother, but I didn't notice a dramatic difference in my pores. It's decent for quick maintenance, just not a game-changer for me.

Honestly, was excited for this because it's supposed to help with pores. However, I think it enlarged my pores. Love that it's easy to use and everything is in one, but want to big of a fan. Hopping it'll help with more use.

avis.titre: The POREfessional Degunker clears out pores and im
avis.texte: The POREfessional Degunker is an excellent pick if you're trying to keep pores clear and skin smooth. It works deeply to unclog pores and remove built-up oil and impurities, which helps your skin feel cleaner and look more refined. I noticed that after a few uses my skin felt smoother and less congested, which made it easier for other skincare or makeup to go on nicely. The exfoliating/cleansing action feels thorough but not harsh, so my skin didn't get irritated or stripped. If you want a cleanser that tackles impurities and leaves your face looking clear and fresh, this one is a win.
Super effective, it helped remove blackheads from my skin and deeply cleanse my pores. It was gentle and left my skin a little red, but the redness disappeared after 10 minutes.

The porefesshional Degunker from benefit cosmetics is a great face mask and tool in the meantime. When I first use the mask I felt a very nice and cooling sensation. Using the tool afterwards was easy I didn't know that I have that much gunk in my skin. The tool was easy to use but I wish if the company could put extra explanation on how to use it. It left my skin soft and clean will definitely use it again.

The Porefessional Degunker works incredibly well! It removes blackheads fast and leaves my skin super smooth without irritation. After just a couple of uses, my texture improved and my face looked much clearer. Easy to use, gentle, and honestly better than most products I've tried. Highly recommend!
It actually works! I love the easy application of the solution and how the tip is detachable making it easy to clean. I even use it without the solution because the extraction works well.

I used this product as directed, on a clean/damp face after showering at night. The product is thick and within a short time you can feel a minty sensation that makes your face feel clean. After 15 minutes and rinsing the product off with warm water, the applicator cap has a flat tip to gently glide across your face. Personally, I was hoping to see blackheads/whiteheads scraped away on the tool--but did not see anything. The product did make my face feel a lot cleaner, but I personally did not notice a difference in my blackheads/whiteheads over time of using this product twice a week for a month.

I have pretty large pores that get clogged, so I was really excited to try this product. I followed the instructions and got some gunk out, but not as much as I had hoped or have gotten out with other tools. It's good if you just need surface level pore removal, but I personally need deeper and this just didn't meet that. It also has a smell (as many of these types of products do) that wasn't my favorite either

avis.titre: Easy to use, removes oil, slightly strange smell
avis.texte: I really loved the design of this product with a built-in extraction tool and facial cleanser in one. However, the actual formula had a pretty strong sulfur smell. It definitely made my skin feel smoother after application and helped with oily skin, but didn't do the best job at removing any clogged pores. I did enjoy how easy the product was to use.
I don't like the smell when applied to my face. It feels a little itchy on the face. It removes blackheads on your face with a tool. You will feel red and soft after use.

avis.titre: Mask is great! Don't get the remover thing
avis.texte: I have tried this several times and I do really like the mask part of this product. I don't really get the "gunk remover" thing though. It doesn't seem to remove anything from my skin. But the mask is great and makes my skin really nice and smooth!
Somehow it's got a weird smell but not strong. I don't really have a lot of blackhead or anything so it's not really seeing anything after one use.

avis.titre: A gentle but effective pore-clearing mask that lea
avis.texte: I have combination skin and this mask worked surprisingly well for deep cleaning my pores. The texture is smooth, spreads easily, and doesn't feel harsh or drying. After rinsing, my skin looked clearer and less congested, especially around the nose. It doesn't provide "coverage" like makeup, but it definitely improves the overall appearance of the skin. I also like that it doesn't leave any tight feeling and can be used even on sensitive areas.

avis.titre: Visible results after just one use
avis.texte: I can see results after just one use. This Benefit Cosmetics Degunker is easy to use. You apply the formula for a few minutes and then rinse off. Then you reattach the tool and slide it over the areas of skin treated to remove gunk, excess oils, and residue from your everyday life. Excited to see the results after a few uses. Will update!

avis.titre: Did nothing except make my skin red
avis.texte: I wanted to love this so bad, because I love Benefits products but this was a miss for me. I have fairly congested skin and large pores, so I really thought this would help even a little bit. I applied the product and let it sit for the duration of time in the instructions. Once I washed it off, my skin was so red. I figured maybe it's a temporary side effect, but my skin was still red the next morning in that area. And pretty much none of my blackheads came out, so the product really didn't do anything aside from make my skin irritated. The first picture is my skin before, and the last picture is the following morning.

I've been using Benefit's POREfessional Degunker and I like it! It does a great job at refreshing my pores and giving my skin a smoother feel. The scent isn't my favorite, but that's a small trade off for how effective it is. Quick, easy, and really helps my skin feel clean and prepped definitely a handy addition to my routine!

I wanted to love this product but I just don't know how I feel. I like the concept of it, but I don't know if it worked for me. I will keep testing it to see if it ends working for me but so far I'm not seeing a difference. I like the formula of the mask. It doesn't have a scent and it does feel good on the skin.

I mostly used this around my nose. I found it easy to apply and rinse off. The packaging was also easy to open and had multiple uses. The scent was light and non irritating. I feel like it will be helpful to clear out my pores. I like the little tool on the end but be careful so you don't push too hard and hurt yourself.

The product is so nice, the packaging is cute and not not complicated to use. The smell is not my favorite but it does make my face smaller and my pores is not as big as before. I have less oily skin which I like. For me it worth buying and okay with the cost.
I wanted to love this, but the metal part is just too rough on your skin. I did not notice a difference in my skin or pores. It was painful to use the metal tool and my skin was very red after.

Honeslty very good at getting everything out! A little tricky at first trying to figure it out but it's a very easy to use and helpful tool. I really enjoy it and have seen change in my pores and will continue to use it from now on.

I've been really impressed with The Porefessional Degunker. It melts away makeup, sunscreen, and buildup without stripping my skin. After a few uses, my pores looked smoother and less congested, especially around my T-zone. The texture feels lightweight and rinses off easily, and it layers great with the rest of my nighttime routine. If you struggle with clogged pores or want that clean, refreshed feeling, this is such a good addition to your skincare lineup.

avis.titre: Did not do anything for me
avis.texte: I did not care for this product. I used it as prescribed on the back of the tube but didn't see any results or change. I left the cream on for 15' and rinsed with warm water, then scraped, which is not so easy when used on the nose or chin, and left me with some redness and slight burn feelings. I've had better results with less pain.

avis.titre: I want to like it so bad!
avis.texte: I'm not sure how I feel about this product. It smells very off. I'm not sure if it really did anything. There is some difference but it was somewhat painful and not worth the result.
It works so well, it has clean ingredients and it's very easy to use. I love it. It doesn't have a strong smell and it's made my nose so clean. I recommend this 💯
After testing this product, I will say it works, but scraping the blackheads off your nose with the metal scraper. It is a little rough on the nose, but it definitely gets a job done.

This product is pretty good if you are consistent with using it. It does remove some of your pores but not all. The application is easy but the instructions are not the best. The product is not uncomfortable. It is refreshing after you use it. Overall this product is a 7.5/10.

I really like this tool because it's easy inconvenient with a serum and the deer all in one. I feel like there's not a lot of serum so you probably would have to get a new tool fairly quickly like within a month if you're using this product regularly. However, I do think it could work as the tool on its own with a different serum that you might have in your routine. I really like how easy it is to get all of the junk out of my pores, especially in my nose, where there's a lot of buildup and it's easy to clean as well.

This product definitely works to help clear your pores of all that gunk. The scent is not the best and you do get a slight tingling from the product doing its job. Being that you only need to use this product 1-2x a week i think the size fair enough. Overall great product.

Won't lie, I still can't figure this out. I've bruised my nose from jabbing the metal piece into a crease on accident. The cleanser works well, not sure how well but the metal junk remover needs some work.
Used on my teenage daughter and it cleared her skin up. I also used it. Its texture is thick and cleared the skin up in no time. We also used it on my husbands nose.

avis.titre: Clears pores instantly, smooths skin, and gives th
avis.texte: I've been struggling with blackheads for a while, and The Porefessional Degunker really delivers! My pores feel instantly cleaner, and my skin looks smoother right after using it. The extraction tool makes it easy to get rid of all the gunk without feeling harsh or painful. Honestly, seeing all the stuff it pulls out is kind of gross but oddly satisfying 😅. My skin definitely feels fresher and more refreshed, and I can see a noticeable difference after just one use. Totally recommend if you want clearer, smoother pores!

avis.titre: Gets worse before it gets better, but it really do
avis.texte: It gets way worse before it gets better. Man, the stuff really drew some stuff out of my face big time the day after I use this all of these little breakouts came through on my face, which is good because it means it works, and it clears it all out, but just make sure that you don't use it right before you have a big event because it will get worse before it gets better. Now three days later my face is crystal clear And my pores are really tiny, but it did bring all of that to the surface the very next day!
This product is amazing. Cleaned my pores reducing breakouts. Did bit try out skin or cause any unwanted reactions. Great coverage and absorbs quick. I would highly recommend/

Benefits professional debunker melts away stubborn makeup and grime while leaving your skin feeling refreshed instead of stripped. It works fast feel lightweight and gives your pores that clean smooth finish everyone wants.

This pore degunker is great for blackheads but I'm not sure about clogged pores on your chin. The texture is very smooth and having the spatula come as an attachment was great. After having it on for 15 min, it didn't get hard like clay but rather stayed smooth like mud.

This product worked way better than expected. It was really easy to use and cleans the pores well. I was able have a deep clean using the removal tool it comes with. It is also super easy to clean the tool after every use. I have sensitive skin and didn't experience irritation on my face.

avis.titre: Can see a noticeable difference after using it
avis.texte: This is an interesting product that I think would work really well for someone with large pores and blackheads. I don't have too many issues with that so I used it on my nose and chin where I have the largest pores. First you apply the formula which is like a clay mask. Then use the extracting tool attached to push across your skin to clear everything out. There was some satisfaction seeing the dead skin come off so I do like it!

The packaging is quite cute, and quickly draws your attention. The texture of the formula is creamy… like a concealer. I do like the way the tool works on my face, especially around my nose. I could see using this as a weekly maintenance.

I tried out the Benefit Cosmetics The Porfessional Degunker and it works very well. I have very large pores on my nose with black heads. It cleaned the blackness off and made my pores look tighter. It didn't irritate my skin. The packaging is a cute purple and stocking stuffer worthy. I highly recommend it and would buy again.
This product is so dang good! My nose feels like a whole different nose! The amount of gunk this pulled out was insane! This is definitely in my everyday use will buy again pile!

avis.titre: Good idea not the right execution
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this product, it seemed like a great tool for clearing out pores at home, but I just found it completely ineffective. The packaging is good, nice size and I like the metal tips flatness, but maybe it needs a little probe to help get into pores. The product dries down nicely without causing my skin irritation. I tried to use it multiple times on a tricky area I wanted some blackheads and congestion gone and it couldn't remove the issue. I'll continue to try to use this tool when necessary but it was kind of a flop for me.

I've tried this a few times and I'm honestly impressed. It gives that deep-clean feeling without stripping your skin, and after rinsing, my face feels smooth, fresh, and visibly clearer. This one is definitely worth adding to your skincare routine!

avis.titre: I would definitely buy the professional mask produ
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised on how well it actually worked! The mask it thick and feels nice on my nose, ones i followed instructions it did take a bunch of gunk off! My pores looked clean and my skin was soft!

It works. I normally have an oily T-zone which causes blackheads in that area. It works after using once. I will say if does have a bit of a funny smell, but not too bad. However, it is a bit harsh on the skin. I do have sensitive skin so this irritated my cheek and chin area. As well as left my nose area pretty dry and irritated. So do not recommend for those with sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Cool applicator for cleaning your pores
avis.texte: I like the applicator the best because it is a more sanitizing and gentle way to clean my pores vs using my hands or other really pointy tools. The formula did not irritate my skin, but I'm also not sure if it makes any differences.

The new Benefit Cosmetics Porefessional Degunker is a pore minimizing mask that processes on your skin for approximately 15 minutes before rinsing off. You then use the built-in degunker to clear out pores. The mask had no scent and felt gentle. My face felt refreshed and pores looked smaller. I had some blocked pores that were cleared when using the tool. I would not say the two work remarkably together. Separately, the mask and tool work great. I did not notice the mask enhancing the tool's use.
I love this thing. I have many blackheads and this item helps take them out. It leaves my skin smooth and works well. I use it once a week and I love it. So glad I found this.

avis.titre: Everyone should try this product to clean out your
avis.texte: I think everyone should try this product! It works great to clean out your pores and it is so easy to use! Comparing this product to others, it is priced fairly.

This is such a cool skincare & tool combo! I've never tried anything like this before but after giving it a shot I'm impressed. It performed as described. It left my skin feeling extra clean and smooth. The scraper tool removal was easy to use too. I've always struggled with blackheads so this is 100% worth buying.
This was good and got some of my pores clean but it made my skin really red. It smells okay too. It's not something to use often for sensitive skin….
I love this!! The spatula feature is awesome. Makes my face feel and look so clean. I'll buy more for sure no matter cost. My daughter also used and loved it.

avis.titre: Kind of confusing on properly using the tool!
avis.texte: I am still learning how to use this tool after letting the green pore prep sit for 15 mins. Kind of confusing on how to properly use the tool but my face does feel very soft and smooth after using. There is little to no scent and I will keep using to see if I see any difference in my skin texture.

avis.titre: May work for some but broke me out
avis.texte: I used this around my nose area where i have the most visible pores. The packaging is quite unique in that you unscrew the tool to access the product. It goes on smoothly with a slight tingling sensation. Left it on for 15 mins and specified. Does not dry so is easy to wash off. No visible difference initially but after using the scraping tool, some dry skin does come off and it does look slightly clearer. However, the next morning I woke up with a few small pimples in the area so I would not use again

The POREfessional Degunker by Benefit is like a mini spa session in a tube. The creamy formula softens skin beautifully, and the stainless steel tip gives that satisfying "clean sweep" feeling without being harsh. After just one use, my pores looked noticeably clearer and smoother. It's a little extra step in my routine, but totally worth it for that fresh, decongested glow.

This is an interesting product that you use 1-2 times a week. You remove the top which has the applicator and squirt the blue cream into your hand. Then you coat your face and wait 15 minutes. After you wash it off, you put the flat applicator cap back on and press the metal piece over your pores to remove any gunk. The blue cream does have a strange earthy scent. Overall, I liked the product and felt like my pores were clearer after a few weeks of using the product.

avis.titre: Very effective in chin and forehead area
avis.texte: I am actually pretty shocked at how well this did. I use the derma pore from dermaflash that is $99+, but the little scrapper on this one works better for my chin and forehead! I will say the dermapore contoured to my better than this one, but it's so much cheaper yet affective. I like too that you prep it with the mask first. My biggest suggestion would be to take a nice steamy shower prior, so your pores are nice and open for extraction!

A very solid product for exfoliation. The instructions on the box are clear and the product itself is easy to use. I am a fan of the stainless steel tip, I think it's great for really getting in there and removing dead skin. The only thing I'll note is to be cautious when using the tip near active breakouts. I have several pimples on my face so I had to make sure I didn't accidentally scrape them. Overall, I think it's a good product to incorporate into your weekly skincare routine if you're looking for deep exfoliation and degunking.

This is an interesting beauty tool. It is easy to use and made my skin feel nice and clean. I was surprised that it didn't feel sticky or itchy when the cream was on my face like others I have used. However, the tool was a bit odd to use and difficult on flatter parts of my face due to the curvature of the metal tool. Works great around the nose. I was surprised that it did de gunk some pores when I was using it, but did not get everything. Will be interesting if with more uses, it becomes easier to use or more effective.

This product is great! The solution doesn't smell great- I'll say that! But it works well. The scraper tool is key, it pops up all the blackheads effortlessly and was easy to use. Definitely recommend if you suffer from blackheads on your nose.

I was very impressed with this Benefit Cosmetics Porefessional Degunker product. I loved how my skin felt and looked after using it and it was definitely oddly satisfying since I am one that unfortunately likes to pick. I look foward to seeing how well my skin looks as I continue using it. I would definitely buy this product once it runs out and recommend it to anyone looking to get a great face cleanse and wanting beautiful soft skin.

It's very effective and it did take a good chunk of my debris out of my skin. The packaging is really nice and it's a good value for your money. I got this product in exchange for honest review. Even the scent is barely nonexistent. Good product overall.

The product goes on very smoothly. It does not have a bad scent. It comes in this cute little tube. I cannot honestly say that it would be a great value for your money as far as cleaning out my pores because I do not have a lot of blackheads. I will say that my face felt smoother after and did look a bit brighter.

I received a full sized tube of Benefit the Professionnel Degunker from Influenster in exchange for my review. I have never tried a product like this one, nor am I aware of any similar items on the market. Typically, I associate degunking with pore strips or peel off face masks. Those types of products also remove hair, which can be painful. I wasn't sure what to expect with this one but definitely intrigued at the concept. The first thing I noticed is the packaging. There is a cap that needs to be removed before revealing a spatula type tool. It has rounded corners and a slightly beveled edge. After unscrewing the spatula, the product is dispensed from the tube with a nozzle top. The product is a bluish gray color, with a clay like consistency. I think if I could change the packaging, I would like the option to unscrew the cap to both reveal either the product or the spatula instead of the spatula first. To me, it makes sense to open the cap to apply the clay, then the spatula rather than vice versa. Prior to application, it is instructed to use on a clean face with damp skin, so I washed my face first. It has a smooth, thinner consistency than clay. I used it on both my nose and chin area, as those are the areas with the most sebum. I don't have too many blackheads as it is approaching the colder months. It is mostly the clogged pores that I wanted cleared up. I had to wait for 15 minutes before scraping the tool across my face. The tool is a bit tricky to use around the no

I'm honestly not too sure about this product. I think the concept of it is great however it does not seem to do what it's advertised to do. I still had blackheads on my nose after using the product and following the instructions. It reminds me somewhat of a clay mask. I really do like the concept of the scraper. It seems pretty cool. The smell is not overwhelming or does not have a weird chemically smell. personally, I feel like it was not effective for myself.

It a really good product if you're trying to get rid of stubborn black heads, or anything on your face. The scent is very mild so it doesn't bother you. The product itself isn't expensive for what it does! Wayyyy cheaper than heading to an esthetician to do the same thing for triple the price. I recommend this to anyone who struggles with blackheads like me!
I really like the packaging and the little degunking tool. It works really well and leaves my skin feeling clean and great. I received free for my review.

I have been looking for a safe and effective way to remove the buildup of clogged pores on my nose, so I was super excited to try this product. While I am still getting used to using it, I really like this product so far and thought it did a good job of loosening up the oil/dead skin in my pores for removal. The tool is a little difficult to use in all crevices of my nose, so I go in with my fingers when needed. The packaging is super clever and compact. I do not notice an overwhelming scent and find it pleasant to use on my oily sensitive skin. Overall for the value, if you have been looking for a way to extract your pores, you get a tool and a mask in one!
i love this! the mask is so nice and really clears my skin well. I love the texture of it and the way it maws my skin feel! this for so many pores out! can't wait to keep using
Have used the product a few times and honestly haven't noticed that much of a difference. The blue color was a nice surprise, doesn't smell to bad either

My new favorite cleanser. It works like a charm. Even my teenager approved of the results when she tested it out. You apply, a little goes a long way, wait 15m and then wash off. Once dry you can use the tool that is attached to the tube. It really gets everything out of there and cleans so well.

avis.titre: Light Face mask for the nose!
avis.texte: The packaging was really nice and easy to use, the mask helped aid with the roughness and remove any outer surface debris on the nose. The mask didn't feel uncomfortable and the scent was neutral, it didn't bother at all. The only problem is it didn't fully extract the blackheads, maybe more frequent usage aside from 2x a week will improve the outcome.
This product is amazing, just only 1 treatment already showed affective, my skin was a little dull, now is so shiny, smells nice, the packaging so easy to use, travel or home, I highly recommend it.

• Excellent Pore Cleansing Effectiveness: The product truly helps dissolve and remove dirt and excess oil trapped deep within the pores. After use, I felt my skin was much more deeply cleansed than with just using a regular facial cleanser, especially in the nose and chin area. • Improved Skin Texture: The unclogging of pores helps the skin surface become smoother and less rough. This is a good foundation for subsequent skincare products to absorb better. • Pleasant Fragrance: The product has a light, refreshing scent characteristic of the POREfessional line, creating a relaxing feeling during use. • Convenient Packaging Design: The tube packaging makes it easy to dispense the product, is hygienic, and allows for controlled usage.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've used devices similar to the manual tool attachment on this product. While it wasn't ineffective, I felt that it was futile to use against pores that constantly "refilled" (gross!). When I got this product, I wasn't sure if I would like it because of that past experience. I have sebaceous filaments on my nose that I mostly leave alone as much as I'd like to be rid of them. I used this product as instructed, with the mask for 15 minutes, then the tool on wet skin, which was perfectly curved to fit all the grooves of my nose. The familiar relief of getting all that gunk out washed over me but would it last? Over the next two days, the pores not only remained empty but I felt that the texture of my skin got… better? I was impressed! In fact, I haven't been this impressed with a Benefit product since Benetint. That being said, because this product is meant to help with extractions, I would not recommend using more than once or twice a week and to be very careful with the extraction tool so as not to go overboard and cause inflammation or broken capillaries. I think it's important to also note that sebaceous filaments are completely normal and it would not be realistic to expect that this product, or any other, could get rid of them entirely and keep them away. It is normal to have visible pores especially in the nasal region. All that put together, I think this is an effective product! Even if you didn't use this regul

It makes it more compact, plus you won't lose the tool because it's attached to the tube!
